title: Oga at the Top
tagline: Your sister paid ₦50,000 for the letter. The oga who signed it has retired. Interview is 2pm, and it is 7am.

bonus.label: Keep your dignity
bonus.lostMessage: You paid and begged too much. Your sister hears about it before you reach home.
bonus.earnedLine: You walked into that ministry with your head still high.

connection_verified.label: Old oga's driver is with you

secretary_owe.label: Madam Grace remembers you
secretary_owe.tip: Hustle gets easier, gragra gets harder.

wrong_floor.label: You went to the wrong office

other_candidate.label: The other person has a letter too

sister_pride.label: Your sister's name is still clean

family_shame.label: Your sister will hear about this

morning_panic.title: The Letter Is Useless

text.default: 7am. Your phone rings before the alarm. It's your sister. "The oga who signed your letter has retired. His replacement resumes today. I don't know him." She paid ₦50,000 for that letter and she is trying not to cry about it. Interview is 2pm at the Federal Ministry of Establishment. Light is off and your phone is on 9%. You have ₦15,000, and {rival} is going for the same job.
text.coop: 7am. Your phone rings before the alarm. It's your sister. "The oga who signed your letter has retired. His replacement resumes today. I don't know him." She paid ₦50,000 for that letter and she is trying not to cry about it. Interview is 2pm at the Federal Ministry of Establishment. Light is off and your phone is on 9%. You have ₦15,000, and {partner} is meant to help.
text.solo: 7am. Your phone rings before the alarm. It's your sister. "The oga who signed your letter has retired. His replacement resumes today. I don't know him." You have ₦15,000 and one faded connection.

morning_panic.stakes: Your sister paid ₦50,000 for this. Miss the 2pm slot and it was for nothing.

choices.label: Call your sister back and ask who else knows the new oga
Take a taxi straight to the ministry and wait outside his office

lock.reason: You don't have transport money left.

choices.label: Tell the old oga's driver the new oga is expecting you
Look up the new oga's name and last posting online

recap.default: {winner} calls back and lets her cry for a minute. Then she remembers: the new oga's secretary is from her village. "Her name is Grace. Write it down."
recap.coop: You call back and let her cry for a minute. Then she remembers: the new oga's secretary is from her village. "Her name is Grace. Write it down."

recap.default: {winner} gets a taxi before the fuel queue builds and reaches the park behind the ministry by eight. It costs ₦3,000. {loser} is still looking for a clean shirt.
recap.coop: You get a taxi before the fuel queue builds and reach the park behind the ministry by eight. It costs ₦3,000.

recap.default: {winner} tells the old oga's driver that the new oga is expecting them. He laughs down the phone. "Oga, that one no dey office today. Try tomorrow."
recap.coop: You tell the old oga's driver that the new oga is expecting you. He laughs down the phone. "Oga, that one no dey office today. Try tomorrow."

recap.coop: You find him on the ministry's Facebook page: Dr. Ibrahim Sule, transferred from Kano last week. The driver in the photo is Musa, standing beside a black Prado.

recap.default: {winner} calls back but their sister is too upset to remember anything. She says "sorry" four times and the line drops. Battery is 7%.
recap.coop: You call back but your sister is too upset to remember anything. She says "sorry" four times and the line drops. Battery is 7%.

recap.default: {winner} takes a taxi and the driver drops them at a bus stop two kilometres short. "Traffic. Walk." That is ₦3,000 for a view of a bus stop.
recap.coop: You take a taxi and the driver drops you at a bus stop two kilometres short. "Traffic. Walk." That is ₦3,000 for a view of a bus stop.

recap.default: {winner} calls the old oga's driver. "Who give you my number?" He hangs up, then calls somebody else.
recap.coop: You call the old oga's driver. "Who give you my number?" He hangs up, then calls somebody else.

recap.default: {winner} opens the ministry website. It still lists the old oga, in agbada. Data runs out before the page finishes loading.
recap.coop: You open the ministry website. It still lists the old oga, in agbada. Data runs out before the page finishes loading.

tie.recap: You both reach the ministry bus stop at the same time. The only taxi left charges for two.

sister_network.title: Madam Grace from the Village
sister_network.text: Your sister sends a number. "Grace. New oga's secretary. Tell her you are my brother. She owes me from when her son was sick." You call. A tired woman answers over printers and somebody laughing too loud. "Yes? Who is this?" It is nine in the morning and she already sounds like it is evening.
sister_network.stakes: Grace decides who gets in front of the new oga. Annoy her and you queue until 2pm.

choices.label: Greet her warmly and use your sister's name
Offer to "appreciate" her if your file goes on top

lock.reason: You don't have money to appreciate anybody.

choices.label: Say the new oga already knows you and you're confirming the time
Ask about her son before you ask for anything

recap.default: {winner} says "Aunty Grace" and mentions their sister. The printers go quiet behind her. "That woman saved my son." She gives the time: 2pm, Room 402. {loser} is still dialling wrong numbers.
recap.coop: You say "Aunty Grace" and mention your sister. The printers go quiet behind her. "That woman saved my son." She gives the time: 2pm, Room 402.

recap.default: {winner} offers to appreciate her. Grace is silent for a second. "Bring it when you come." She gives Room 402 in a voice you could chill zobo in.
recap.coop: You offer to appreciate her. Grace is silent for a second. "Bring it when you come." She gives Room 402 in a voice you could chill zobo in.

recap.default: {winner} says the new oga knows them. "Which oga?" They get his name wrong. She gives Room 205, the old oga's office, and hangs up.
recap.coop: You say the new oga knows you. "Which oga?" You get his name wrong. She gives Room 205, the old oga's office, and hangs up.

recap.default: {winner} asks about her son. Grace talks for ten minutes while a printer jams behind her. Then they say your sister's name and she goes quiet. "Come at 1:30. I will prepare him."
recap.coop: You ask about her son. Grace talks for ten minutes while a printer jams behind her. Then you say your sister's name and she goes quiet. "Come at 1:30. I will prepare him."

recap.default: {winner} calls her "Aunty Grace" and gets the sister's name wrong. "I don't know that one." She gives the general line: 2pm, come and queue.
recap.coop: You call her "Aunty Grace" and get the sister's name wrong. "I don't know that one." She gives the general line: 2pm, come and queue.

recap.default: {winner} hints at appreciation and Grace hears how thin it is. "Come at 2pm like everybody else." Somebody in her office laughs.
recap.coop: You hint at appreciation and Grace hears how thin it is. "Come at 2pm like everybody else." Somebody in her office laughs.

recap.default: {winner} says the oga knows them. "I am his secretary. He tells me everything. He did not mention you." She hangs up before they can ask for a room.
recap.coop: You say the oga knows you. "I am his secretary. He tells me everything. He did not mention you." She hangs up before you can ask for a room.

recap.default: {winner} asks about her son. "This is an office line, not a family meeting." She gives 2pm, Room 402, and puts the phone down hard.
recap.coop: You ask about her son. "This is an office line, not a family meeting." She gives 2pm, Room 402, and puts the phone down hard.

tie.recap: You both ring the same number and get the same answer: 2pm, Room 402. Grace is too busy to remember either of you.

new_oga_gist.title: Dr. Ibrahim Sule
new_oga_gist.text: Dr. Ibrahim Sule, transferred from Kano last week. Former Director of Personnel, no scandal, no gist. But his driver Musa came with him, and your cousin's friend knows Musa's brother in Sabon Gari. It is thin. It is also all you have, and it is half past nine.
new_oga_gist.stakes: A name is not access. Turn it into a door before the 2pm slot fills.

choices.label: Call your cousin's friend and ask him to reach Musa's brother
Go to the ministry and find Musa with ₦2,000 for his trouble
Tell security you are Dr. Sule's nephew from Kano
Call Dr. Sule's old office in Kano and ask about him

recap.default: {winner} works the chain: cousin, friend, Musa's brother, Musa. By ten Musa is waving from the driver's shed. "You be the one from Lagos?"
recap.coop: You work the chain: cousin, friend, Musa's brother, Musa. By ten Musa is waving from the driver's shed. "You be the one from Lagos?"

recap.default: {winner} finds Musa behind the building. He takes the ₦2,000 into his cap. "I go tell oga say you dey come."
recap.coop: You find Musa behind the building. He takes the ₦2,000 into his cap. "I go tell oga say you dey come."

recap.default: {winner} says "nephew from Kano" and the guard writes it down. He calls upstairs. "Dr. Sule say he no get nephew for Lagos." The guard writes that down too.
recap.coop: You say "nephew from Kano" and the guard writes it down. He calls upstairs. "Dr. Sule say he no get nephew for Lagos." The guard writes that down too.

recap.default: {winner} calls Kano and a clerk who has been waiting for somebody to talk to picks up. "Dr. Sule? That one no like long talk. Answer direct." {loser} is still asking relatives who Dr. Sule is.
recap.coop: You call Kano and a clerk who has been waiting for somebody to talk to picks up. "Dr. Sule? That one no like long talk. Answer direct."

recap.default: {winner} calls the cousin's friend, who calls Musa's brother, who is not picking. The chain ends at a ringing phone in Sabon Gari.
recap.coop: You call the cousin's friend, who calls Musa's brother, who is not picking. The chain ends at a ringing phone in Sabon Gari.

recap.default: {winner} finds Musa. He takes the ₦2,000 and says "Oga busy today. Come tomorrow." The money does not come back.
recap.coop: You find Musa. He takes the ₦2,000 and says "Oga busy today. Come tomorrow." The money does not come back.

recap.default: {winner} says "nephew from Kano" and the guard laughs. "Every day we get ten nephews. Go and queue."
recap.coop: You say "nephew from Kano" and the guard laughs. "Every day we get ten nephews. Go and queue."

recap.default: {winner} calls Kano. Somebody answers, says "Wrong number," and hangs up. The second try goes straight to a switched-off phone.
recap.coop: You call Kano. Somebody answers, says "Wrong number," and hangs up. The second try goes straight to a switched-off phone.

tie.recap: You both reach the ministry with the same information and argue about who called Musa first.

driver_bust.title: Wrong Information
driver_bust.text: The old oga's driver played you. The new oga is in office; his black Prado with Kano plates sits in the VIP slot. Your lie reached the gate before you did, and somebody here already thinks you are a fraud. Fix it before it reaches the fourth floor.
driver_bust.stakes: A fraud's name gets no card. Clean yours before the 2pm slot.

choices.label: Call the driver back and laugh it off: "You caught me, Oga"
Find the new oga's secretary and explain the mix-up
Insist you spoke to the new oga personally yesterday
Drop the driver and start fresh at the ministry gate

recap.default: {winner} calls back and laughs. The driver laughs too. "You get liver. Oga dey office. Dr. Sule, Room 402." He gives it for free, which is how you know he is enjoying himself.
recap.coop: You call back and laugh. The driver laughs too. "You get liver. Oga dey office. Dr. Sule, Room 402." He gives it for free, which is how you know he is enjoying himself.

recap.default: {winner} finds Grace and explains. She listens with her eyes on her screen. "At least you are honest. 2pm, Room 402. Don't mention that driver again."
recap.coop: You find Grace and explain. She listens with her eyes on her screen. "At least you are honest. 2pm, Room 402. Don't mention that driver again."

recap.default: {winner} says "I spoke to him yesterday." The guard calls upstairs. "Dr. Sule say he never hear your name." Two people in the queue turn to look.
recap.coop: You say "I spoke to him yesterday." The guard calls upstairs. "Dr. Sule say he never hear your name." Two people in the queue turn to look.

recap.default: {winner} walks to the gate and starts again. Baba Nuru has seen this before. "Third person today with wrong information. Wait, I go help you."
recap.coop: You walk to the gate and start again. Baba Nuru has seen this before. "Third person today with wrong information. Wait, I go help you."

recap.default: {winner} calls back. It rings out. Three tries later a recorded voice says the number is busy.
recap.coop: You call back. It rings out. Three tries later a recorded voice says the number is busy.

recap.default: {winner} finds Grace's desk. "Come back by 12." They wait on the bench in the sun, next to a man eating groundnuts.
recap.coop: You find Grace's desk. "Come back by 12." You wait on the bench in the sun, next to a man eating groundnuts.

recap.default: {winner} insists the driver is confused. The guard writes their name in the visitors' book under "suspicious". "We go monitor you."
recap.coop: You insist the driver is confused. The guard writes your name in the visitors' book under "suspicious". "We go monitor you."

recap.default: {winner} reaches the gate but Baba Nuru is on break. The man covering knows nothing and says so slowly, twice.
recap.coop: You reach the gate but Baba Nuru is on break. The man covering knows nothing and says so slowly, twice.

tie.recap: You both work out the driver lied at the same time and reach the gate together, arguing over whose phone to blame.

ministry_gate.title: Baba Nuru at the Gate
ministry_gate.text: The ministry gate. A white building, a long queue and a visitors' book on a plastic table. Baba Nuru has been gateman for twenty years. He looks at your ID tag before he looks at you. "You get appointment?" Behind him the generator coughs, and every minute here is a minute off your 2pm.
ministry_gate.stakes: Baba Nuru decides who goes up. Waste time here and the 2pm slot goes to somebody else.

choices.label: Greet him like an old friend and mention your father
Slide ₦500 under your ID: "For your morning, Baba"
Show him the old oga's letter and say it is still valid
Ask which floor Dr. Sule is on and which stairs

recap.default: {winner} greets him by name and mentions their father. Baba Nuru almost smiles. "That man get sense. Room 402. Wait for me downstairs, I get gist." {loser} is still holding out an ID.
recap.coop: You greet him by name and mention your father. Baba Nuru almost smiles. "That man get sense. Room 402. Wait for me downstairs, I get gist."

recap.default: {winner} slips ₦500 under their ID. Baba Nuru folds it into his palm without looking down. "Room 402. Sign the book."
recap.coop: You slip ₦500 under your ID. Baba Nuru folds it into his palm without looking down. "Room 402. Sign the book."

recap.default: {winner} holds up the old oga's letter. Baba Nuru reads it slowly and shakes his head. "That oga don go. New oga, new letter." He writes something in the book.
recap.coop: You hold up the old oga's letter. Baba Nuru reads it slowly and shakes his head. "That oga don go. New oga, new letter." He writes something in the book.

recap.default: {winner} asks for the floor. Baba Nuru nods, almost impressed. "Room 402, fourth floor, staircase B. Lift don spoil since last week."
recap.coop: You ask for the floor. Baba Nuru nods, almost impressed. "Room 402, fourth floor, staircase B. Lift don spoil since last week."

recap.default: {winner} greets him warmly and gets his name wrong. "My name no be Nuru. Go and learn name before you greet person." He points at the long form.
recap.coop: You greet him warmly and get his name wrong. "My name no be Nuru. Go and learn name before you greet person." He points at the long form.

recap.default: {winner} holds out the ₦500 and Baba Nuru steps back as if it is hot. "You think this is market?" He hands over the long form and a pen that does not write.
recap.coop: You hold out the ₦500 and Baba Nuru steps back as if it is hot. "You think this is market?" He hands over the long form and a pen that does not write.

recap.default: {winner} insists the letter is valid. Baba Nuru picks up the desk phone. "Oga, come and see this one."
recap.coop: You insist the letter is valid. Baba Nuru picks up the desk phone. "Oga, come and see this one."

recap.default: {winner} asks for the floor. "Why you no know? You sure say you get appointment?" He rings upstairs and makes them wait with the queue.
recap.coop: You ask for the floor. "Why you no know? You sure say you get appointment?" He rings upstairs and makes you wait with the queue.

tie.recap: Baba Nuru gets tired of both of you. "Go before I change my mind."

secretary_office.title: Madam Grace's Desk
secretary_office.text: Room 402, outer office, 11am. Grace types without looking up. The room smells of old paper and Bournvita. Three other people wait on plastic chairs: two men in suits and a woman holding her folder like a shield. Grace points at a seat. "Sit. He will call." The inner door is open a crack.
secretary_office.stakes: Grace controls the door. When the oga asks "who is next", you want your name in her mouth.

choices.label: Compliment her office: "Madam, you arrange am well"
Ask quietly if you can "drop something for her lunch"
Tell her Dr. Sule is expecting you, so no queue
Sit quietly and read the oga's mood from who comes out

recap.default: {winner} tells Grace the office is well arranged. She looks up for the first time. "You sabi talk. Sit there. I go call you first." The man in the grey suit shifts his chair. {loser} is still waiting with the others.
recap.coop: You tell Grace the office is well arranged. She looks up for the first time. "You sabi talk. Sit there. I go call you first." The man in the grey suit shifts his chair.

recap.default: {winner} asks about "something for her lunch". Grace takes the envelope without smiling. "I go see wetin I fit do." It is not a promise.
recap.coop: You ask about "something for her lunch". Grace takes the envelope without smiling. "I go see wetin I fit do." It is not a promise.

recap.default: {winner} says the oga is expecting them. Grace picks up the phone. "Sir, somebody say you dey expect am." She listens. "He say he no know you. Wait your turn." The whole room heard it.
recap.coop: You say the oga is expecting you. Grace picks up the phone. "Sir, somebody say you dey expect am." She listens. "He say he no know you. Wait your turn." The whole room heard it.

recap.default: {winner} sits and watches. The first man comes out sweating, the woman comes out smiling. Grace notices. "You get patience. I like that."
recap.coop: You sit and watch. The first man comes out sweating, the woman comes out smiling. Grace notices. "You get patience. I like that."

recap.default: {winner} compliments the office. "Thank you. Sit down." She has not stopped typing.
recap.coop: You compliment the office. "Thank you. Sit down." She has not stopped typing.

recap.default: {winner} offers the envelope and Grace pushes it back across the desk. "This is a federal ministry, not Oshodi market." The woman with the folder looks up.
recap.coop: You offer the envelope and Grace pushes it back across the desk. "This is a federal ministry, not Oshodi market." The woman with the folder looks up.

recap.default: {winner} says the oga is expecting them. "Everybody here says that. Queue there." She points at the back, behind the folder woman.
recap.coop: You say the oga is expecting you. "Everybody here says that. Queue there." She points at the back, behind the folder woman.

recap.default: {winner} sits and watches. Everybody comes out with the same tired face. Grace never looks at them once.
recap.coop: You sit and watch. Everybody comes out with the same tired face. Grace never looks at you once.

tie.recap: You both sit in the outer office, ignored, while the wall clock ticks toward two.

wrong_office.title: Room 205
wrong_office.text: Room 205. The nameplate still says "Director" but the room is empty: chairs stacked on the desk, one dead computer, a calendar from last year. A cleaner sweeps around your feet. "Oga don go. New oga dey upstairs." You have lost half an hour and nobody can say which floor upstairs is.
wrong_office.stakes: Every wrong floor costs time you do not have. Find Room 402 before the 2pm slot goes.

choices.label: Ask the cleaner politely which way to Room 402
Run up the stairs and check every floor
Knock on an office and say you're from the new oga's office
Go back to the lobby and read the building directory

recap.default: {winner} asks the cleaner and he drops his broom. "Room 402? Why you no talk since?" He walks them to staircase B. "Fourth floor, turn left."
recap.coop: You ask the cleaner and he drops his broom. "Room 402? Why you no talk since?" He walks you to staircase B. "Fourth floor, turn left."

recap.default: {winner} takes the stairs two at a time and finds Room 402 on the fourth floor, soaked through. Grace looks up. "Sit. Catch your breath." {loser} is already seated and calm.
recap.coop: You take the stairs two at a time and find Room 402 on the fourth floor, soaked through. Grace looks up. "Sit. Catch your breath."

recap.default: {winner} knocks and says "from the new oga's office." The woman inside does not look up. "I am from the new oga's office. I don't know you." She calls security.
recap.coop: You knock and say "from the new oga's office." The woman inside does not look up. "I am from the new oga's office. I don't know you." She calls security.

recap.default: {winner} finds the directory by the lift. Room 402, Personnel, fourth floor. They walk up without sweating.
recap.coop: You find the directory by the lift. Room 402, Personnel, fourth floor. You walk up without sweating.

recap.default: {winner} asks nicely. "I just dey sweep. Ask reception." Reception has a queue of nine and one pen.
recap.coop: You ask nicely. "I just dey sweep. Ask reception." Reception has a queue of nine and one pen.

recap.default: {winner} runs up the wrong staircase and comes out on the roof beside a water tank. By the time they find the fourth floor, Grace has called two names.
recap.coop: You run up the wrong staircase and come out on the roof beside a water tank. By the time you find the fourth floor, Grace has called two names.

recap.default: {winner} knocks on a door and the man inside is a director. "You say what?" He says their name into his phone.
recap.coop: You knock on a door and the man inside is a director. "You say what?" He says your name into his phone.

recap.default: {winner} finds the directory. It is two years old and lists Room 402 as Stores. Finding Personnel takes another twenty minutes.
recap.coop: You find the directory. It is two years old and lists Room 402 as Stores. Finding Personnel takes another twenty minutes.

tie.recap: You both wander the corridors, ask the same cleaner twice, and reach Room 402 together, soaked and late.

driver_shed.title: Musa the Driver
driver_shed.text: The driver's shed behind the ministry. Five men in uniform trousers play cards on a bench under a zinc roof. Musa is the youngest, cap still on. He stands up. "You be the one from Lagos?" The others look up. One of them is the old oga's driver, the one who played you. He smirks into his cards.
driver_shed.stakes: Musa can put you in front of the oga. The old driver can spoil it with one sentence.

choices.label: Greet Musa like a brother and ignore the old driver
Pay Musa ₦3,000 to drive you to the oga's house

lock.reason: You can't pay for a ride.

choices.label: Confront the old driver: "You played me this morning. God dey."
Ask Musa what mood Dr. Sule is in today

recap.default: {winner} greets Musa like a brother. The old driver goes back to his cards. Musa walks them to the back stairs. "Oga mood good today. Go."
recap.coop: You greet Musa like a brother. The old driver goes back to his cards. Musa walks you to the back stairs. "Oga mood good today. Go."

recap.default: {winner} pays Musa and he drives to Maitama with the AC off to save fuel. Dr. Sule is surprised to see them at his gate, but he opens it.
recap.coop: You pay Musa and he drives to Maitama with the AC off to save fuel. Dr. Sule is surprised to see you at his gate, but he opens it.

recap.default: {winner} confronts the old driver. He stands up. "You want make I call security?" Musa steps between the two of them. "Abeg, no wahala for here." Somebody has already called.
recap.coop: You confront the old driver. He stands up. "You want make I call security?" Musa steps between the two of them. "Abeg, no wahala for here." Somebody has already called.

recap.default: {winner} asks about the mood and Musa leans in. "He no like long talk. Answer direct. No story."
recap.coop: You ask about the mood and Musa leans in. "He no like long talk. Answer direct. No story."

recap.default: {winner} greets Musa. The old driver whispers something and Musa's face closes. "I go see wetin I fit do." He does nothing.
recap.coop: You greet Musa. The old driver whispers something and Musa's face closes. "I go see wetin I fit do." He does nothing.

recap.default: {winner} holds out ₦3,000. "I no dey do that one. Oga go hear." The shed has gone quiet and every card is face down.
recap.coop: You hold out ₦3,000. "I no dey do that one. Oga go hear." The shed has gone quiet and every card is face down.

recap.default: {winner} confronts the old driver. He calls the shed captain. "Remove this one from here."
recap.coop: You confront the old driver. He calls the shed captain. "Remove this one from here."

recap.default: {winner} asks about Dr. Sule's mood. Musa shrugs. "I just dey drive am. He no dey talk for car."
recap.coop: You ask about Dr. Sule's mood. Musa shrugs. "I just dey drive am. He no dey talk for car."

tie.recap: You both stand at the shed while Musa ignores you and the old driver laughs into his cards.

security_wahala.title: Oga Security
security_wahala.text: The security office. One fluorescent tube, one fan, three plastic chairs. The supervisor is a big man with a moustache and your name already in the book. "You don cause wahala today. Wrong office, wrong name, wrong oga. Who send you?" His tea is going cold and he is in no hurry.
security_wahala.stakes: Every minute in this chair is a minute off the 2pm slot, and your sister's ₦50,000 with it.

choices.label: Apologise with full humility and mention your sister
Offer ₦5,000 to "settle the boys" and forget your name

lock.reason: You have nothing to settle with.

choices.label: Say you know the Permanent Secretary and will report this
Stay quiet until he finishes, then ask what to do

recap.default: {winner} apologises and mentions their sister. The supervisor puts his tea down. "Pele. Go, but behave." He tears out the page. {loser} is still being asked who sent them.
recap.coop: You apologise and mention your sister. The supervisor puts his tea down. "Pele. Go, but behave." He tears out the page.

recap.default: {winner} pushes ₦5,000 across the table. The supervisor looks at it for a long time. "I no dey take bribe." He does not tear the page, and he does not give the money back either.
recap.coop: You push ₦5,000 across the table. The supervisor looks at it for a long time. "I no dey take bribe." He does not tear the page, and he does not give the money back either.

recap.default: {winner} names the Permanent Secretary. The supervisor laughs until his tea shakes. "I be him cousin. You want make I call am?" He writes their name in the big book and sends them up anyway.
recap.coop: You name the Permanent Secretary. The supervisor laughs until his tea shakes. "I be him cousin. You want make I call am?" He writes your name in the big book and sends you up anyway.

recap.default: {winner} waits out the shouting. Then: "What I fit do?" The supervisor blinks. "Sign here say you no go cause wahala again. Go."
recap.coop: You wait out the shouting. Then: "What I fit do?" The supervisor blinks. "Sign here say you no go cause wahala again. Go."

recap.default: {winner} apologises. "Every day people dey sorry. Sit down." It is an hour before he lets them go, and they reach Room 402 with minutes to spare.
recap.coop: You apologise. "Every day people dey sorry. Sit down." It is an hour before he lets you go, and you reach Room 402 with minutes to spare.

recap.default: {winner} offers the money and the supervisor calls two officers. "Escort this one up. Make sure he sign the book." They go up with an officer on each arm.
recap.coop: You offer the money and the supervisor calls two officers. "Escort this one up. Make sure he sign the book." You go up with an officer on each arm.

recap.default: {winner} drops names and the supervisor lifts his phone. "Hello? Yes, one person dey here wey say he know you." They go upstairs with a guard beside them.
recap.coop: You drop names and the supervisor lifts his phone. "Hello? Yes, one person dey here wey say he know you." You go upstairs with a guard beside you.

recap.default: {winner} stays quiet and the supervisor takes it as insult. "You dey form quiet? Sit there." Thirty minutes pass with only the fan for company.
recap.coop: You stay quiet and the supervisor takes it as insult. "You dey form quiet? Sit there." Thirty minutes pass with only the fan for company.

tie.recap: You both sit in the security office and are released together, with minutes to spare.

lobby_wait.title: The Waiting Room
lobby_wait.text: Room 402, 1:45pm. Three candidates left. Grace stacks files and does not look at you. Through the door Dr. Sule's voice asks short questions, one after another. The woman before you comes out smiling. Grace points with her pen. "You. Go in." Your palms are wet and your shirt is damp.
lobby_wait.stakes: One slot, one card. Walk in wrong and your sister's ₦50,000 walks out with you.

choices.label: Walk in smiling: "Good afternoon sir, thank you for seeing me"
Slip Grace one last envelope: "For your trouble, Madam"

lock.reason: You have nothing left to give.

choices.label: Walk in straight-backed and say you know why you are here
Breathe, recall what you learned today, and walk in calm

recap.default: {winner} walks in smiling. Dr. Sule looks up from a file. "You are the one Grace talked about? Sit."
recap.coop: You walk in smiling. Dr. Sule looks up from a file. "You are the one Grace talked about? Sit."

recap.default: {winner} presses the envelope into Grace's hand. She nods once, which for Grace is a blessing. "Go."
recap.coop: You press the envelope into Grace's hand. She nods once, which for Grace is a blessing. "Go."

recap.default: {winner} walks in with a straight back. Dr. Sule raises an eyebrow. "You know why you are here? Tell me."
recap.coop: You walk in with a straight back. Dr. Sule raises an eyebrow. "You know why you are here? Tell me."

recap.default: {winner} walks in, takes the chair and waits. Dr. Sule notices. "You are not shaking. Good."
recap.coop: You walk in, take the chair and wait. Dr. Sule notices. "You are not shaking. Good."

recap.default: {winner} walks in smiling and asks for "Dr. Sulaiman". "That is not my name." The smile stays on, but nothing else does.
recap.coop: You walk in smiling and ask for "Dr. Sulaiman". "That is not my name." The smile stays on, but nothing else does.

recap.default: {winner} tries to pass the envelope. Grace shoves it back loudly. "Not here!" The inner door is open, and Dr. Sule has heard.
recap.coop: You try to pass the envelope. Grace shoves it back loudly. "Not here!" The inner door is open, and Dr. Sule has heard.

recap.default: {winner} walks in too sure of themselves. Dr. Sule goes quiet. "You think this is your father's house?"
recap.coop: You walk in too sure of yourself. Dr. Sule goes quiet. "You think this is your father's house?"

recap.default: {winner} walks in calm and the first question wipes out everything Musa said. They open their mouth and nothing comes out.
recap.coop: You walk in calm and the first question wipes out everything Musa said. You open your mouth and nothing comes out.

tie.recap: You both reach the door together and jam in the frame. Dr. Sule watches without expression.

interview_room.title: Room 402

text.default: Dr. Sule sits behind a desk piled with files, reading glasses on, white shirt ironed this morning. He is younger than you expected. He does not smile. He points at the chair. "Sit. You have five minutes. Why should I give you this job?" A standing fan turns slowly behind him. Two files lie on the desk, yours and one other.
text.coop: Dr. Sule sits behind a desk piled with files, reading glasses on, white shirt ironed this morning. He is younger than you expected. He does not smile. He points at the chair. "Sit. You have five minutes. Why should I give you this job?" A standing fan turns slowly behind him.
text.solo: Dr. Sule sits behind a desk piled with files, reading glasses on, white shirt ironed this morning. He is younger than you expected. He does not smile. He points at the chair. "Sit. You have five minutes. Why should I give you this job?" A standing fan turns slowly behind him.

interview_room.stakes: Five minutes, one card. Everything else you did today only got you the chair.

choices.label: Tell him about your sister's faith in you
Walk him through your three jobs and your qualifications
Tell him you get things done and the ministry needs that
Ask what he needs in this role, then answer it

recap.default: {winner} tells him about their sister. Dr. Sule takes off his glasses. "My own sister did the same for me." He closes the other file.
recap.coop: You tell him about your sister. Dr. Sule takes off his glasses. "My own sister did the same for me." He closes the other file.

recap.default: {winner} lists three jobs and the exams in between. Dr. Sule nods slowly. "So you know what work is." He makes a note.
recap.coop: You list three jobs and the exams in between. Dr. Sule nods slowly. "So you know what work is." He makes a note.

recap.default: {winner} says "I get things done." Dr. Sule leans back. "Getting things done is not the same as doing them right." He opens the other file.
recap.coop: You say "I get things done." Dr. Sule leans back. "Getting things done is not the same as doing them right." He opens the other file.

recap.default: {winner} asks what he needs. Dr. Sule answers for two minutes and they answer each point back. He puts down his pen. "Somebody who listens first. That is rare." {loser} is still explaining themselves in the corridor.
recap.coop: You ask what he needs. Dr. Sule answers for two minutes and you answer each point back. He puts down his pen. "Somebody who listens first. That is rare."

recap.default: {winner} talks about their sister and the tears arrive before the sentence does. Dr. Sule slides a box of tissue across. "Control yourself first. Then come back."
recap.coop: You talk about your sister and the tears arrive before the sentence does. Dr. Sule slides a box of tissue across. "Control yourself first. Then come back."

recap.default: {winner} lists three jobs. "I asked why you want this job, not for your CV." The fan clicks once. They have no second answer.
recap.coop: You list three jobs. "I asked why you want this job, not for your CV." The fan clicks once. You have no second answer.

recap.default: {winner} says "I get things done." "So does everybody in this building. What makes you different?" They look at the ceiling for an answer.
recap.coop: You say "I get things done." "So does everybody in this building. What makes you different?" You look at the ceiling for an answer.

recap.default: {winner} asks what he needs, then argues with his answer. "No, sir, I think you are wrong." Dr. Sule closes the file.
recap.coop: You ask what he needs, then argue with his answer. "No, sir, I think you are wrong." Dr. Sule closes the file.

tie.recap: You both give the same safe answer. Dr. Sule looks bored. "We will be in touch."

oga_house.title: Maitama
oga_house.text: Maitama. Quiet street, high fence, one security man at the gate. Musa parks at eleven and keeps the engine running. Dr. Sule is on his veranda with tea. "You followed me home?" He does not send you away. "You have liver. Tell me why I should not be angry."
oga_house.stakes: He can have you thrown out in front of his neighbours. One wrong sentence and the 2pm slot goes with you.

choices.label: Apologise for the intrusion, then mention your sister's faith
Say you could not risk missing the interview
Say he will never know what he missed if you leave
Ask about Kano first, then say why you need this job

recap.default: {winner} apologises and talks about their sister. Dr. Sule sets down his cup. "My own sister did the same for me. Come to my office at 2pm. Sit in front."
recap.coop: You apologise and talk about your sister. Dr. Sule sets down his cup. "My own sister did the same for me. Come to my office at 2pm. Sit in front."

recap.default: {winner} says they could not risk missing the interview. Dr. Sule laughs. "You made your own door when the first one closed." He writes an address on a napkin. "2pm. Don't be late."
recap.coop: You say you could not risk missing the interview. Dr. Sule laughs. "You made your own door when the first one closed." He writes an address on a napkin. "2pm. Don't be late."

recap.default: {winner} says "I am worth the risk." Dr. Sule stands. "Risk is for the market, not my veranda. See me at the ministry like everybody else." The gate closes behind them.
recap.coop: You say "I am worth the risk." Dr. Sule stands. "Risk is for the market, not my veranda. See me at the ministry like everybody else." The gate closes behind you.

recap.default: {winner} asks about Kano and he talks for twenty minutes, tea going cold. When they finally explain, he nods. "You listen. That is rare." He gives them a direct line.
recap.coop: You ask about Kano and he talks for twenty minutes, tea going cold. When you finally explain, he nods. "You listen. That is rare." He gives you a direct line.

recap.default: {winner} apologises three times. Dr. Sule's face closes. "If you are sorry, why did you come?" He goes inside. The ride back to the ministry is silent.
recap.coop: You apologise three times. Dr. Sule's face closes. "If you are sorry, why did you come?" He goes inside. The ride back to the ministry is silent.

recap.default: {winner} explains and sounds desperate. "You chased me to my house because you are afraid of a queue?" He picks up his cup instead of answering.
recap.coop: You explain and sounds desperate. "You chased me to my house because you are afraid of a queue?" He picks up his cup instead of answering.

recap.default: {winner} says "I am worth the risk" and Dr. Sule calls his security man. "Escort this one out." He looks at the car. "Musa, you are on notice."
recap.coop: You say "I am worth the risk" and Dr. Sule calls his security man. "Escort this one out." He looks at the car. "Musa, you are on notice."

recap.default: {winner} asks about Kano and gets the facts wrong. "I was in Sokoto, not Kano. You did not do your research." He goes inside.
recap.coop: You ask about Kano and get the facts wrong. "I was in Sokoto, not Kano. You did not do your research." He goes inside.

tie.recap: You both turn up at his gate together and argue on the veranda. He sends you both back to the ministry.

interview_fail.title: The Long Walk Home
interview_fail.text: No card. Dr. Sule shook your hand and said "We will be in touch", and you saw him open the other file before you reached the door. The corridor is long and white. Your phone buzzes. It's your sister: "How did it go?"
interview_fail.stakes: She paid ₦50,000 and she is waiting for an answer. Say something before the bus comes.

choices.label: Tell your sister the truth
Tell her you will try another ministry tomorrow
Lie and say you got it
Say nothing yet and walk to the bus park

recap.default: {winner} tells their sister the truth. She is quiet for a long time. "Come home. I made jollof."
recap.coop: You tell your sister the truth. She is quiet for a long time. "Come home. I made jollof."

recap.default: {winner} says "I will try again." Sister: "I know you will. That is why I am not worried."
recap.coop: You say "I will try again." Sister: "I know you will. That is why I am not worried."

recap.default: {winner} lies. Sister screams so loud the phone crackles, and somebody in her shop claps. It is a good sound, and they will have to live with it.
recap.coop: You lie. Sister screams so loud the phone crackles, and somebody in her shop claps. It is a good sound, and you will have to live with it.

recap.default: {winner} walks to the bus park without answering. The city is loud and their own steps are louder. Tomorrow will be smarter.
recap.coop: You walk to the bus park without answering. The city is loud and your own steps are louder. Tomorrow will be smarter.

recap.default: {winner} tries to tell the truth and the words will not come. Sister hears the silence. "Come home," she says.
recap.coop: You try to tell the truth and the words will not come. Sister hears the silence. "Come home," she says.

recap.default: {winner} says "other ministries" like they are reading it off a card. Sister knows. She always knows.
recap.coop: You say "other ministries" like you are reading it off a card. Sister knows. She always knows.

recap.default: {winner} lies and forgets the details. "Which ministry?" Sister asks. They have no answer before the bus arrives.
recap.coop: You lie and forget the details. "Which ministry?" Sister asks. You have no answer before the bus arrives.

recap.coop: You walk too long and miss the last bus. The night goes on a bench opposite the ministry gate, watching it.

tie.recap: You both call your sisters at the same time, on opposite sides of the gate. Neither of you tells the whole truth.

endings.win: You fumble the interview, but {loser}'s day collapsed harder. Dr. Sule rubs his eyes, closes both files and picks the one who at least stayed in the room. You get a card, and a very long Monday.
endings.loss: Dr. Sule shakes your hand and says "We'll be in touch," but he has already opened {winner}'s file. Your sister says come home, she made jollof.

success.default: It is not the offer you wanted, but you both walk out with Dr. Sule's direct line and a second interview next month.
success.solo: It is not the offer you wanted, but you walk out with Dr. Sule's direct line and a second interview next month.

endings.fail: You didn't get the job. Your sister says come home, she made jollof, and the ministry gate closes behind you at 4pm.

interview_success.title: The Offer
interview_success.text: Dr. Sule stands and offers his hand. "Welcome to the ministry. Report Monday, eight o'clock." He writes on a card. "Give this to HR. They will process your clearance." The card is thin, with a stamp that has not dried. In the corridor the other candidates look up and read your face.
interview_success.stakes: The card is in your hand, but HR closes at four and the clerks are slow.

choices.label: Call your sister before you do anything else
Walk straight to HR with the card
Walk past the other candidates and let them see the card
Sit outside for five minutes and let it sink in

recap.default: {winner} calls their sister. She screams so loud the security man looks up. "I knew it," she keeps saying. "I knew it."
recap.coop: You call your sister. She screams so loud the security man looks up. "I knew it," she keeps saying. "I knew it."

recap.default: {winner} takes the card to HR. The clerk asks for three documents they do not have, then reads the stamp and stops. "Sit. I will see what I can do."
recap.coop: You take the card to HR. The clerk asks for three documents you do not have, then reads the stamp and stops. "Sit. I will see what I can do."

recap.default: {winner} walks past the other candidates with the card held at chest height. Nobody says anything. The man in the grey suit looks at his shoes. {loser} is still holding their file.
recap.coop: You walk past the other candidates with the card held at chest height. Nobody says anything. The man in the grey suit looks at his shoes.

recap.default: {winner} sits on the ministry steps. The sun is hot and they do not feel it. The card is in their pocket and Monday is two days away.
recap.coop: You sit on the ministry steps. The sun is hot and you do not feel it. The card is in your pocket and Monday is two days away.

recap.default: {winner} calls their sister. It rings out. They leave a voice note that sounds like begging her to believe it. She will. They wish it had come out better.
recap.coop: You call your sister. It rings out. You leave a voice note that sounds like begging her to believe it. She will. You wish it had come out better.

recap.default: {winner} rushes to HR and leaves the card on Dr. Sule's desk. They run back. He is holding it up. "Almost," he says.
recap.coop: You rush to HR and leave the card on Dr. Sule's desk. You run back. He is holding it up. "Almost," he says.

recap.default: {winner} shows the card around and drops it in the corridor. A cleaner hands it back. "Congratulations, sir." They feel smaller than when they started.
recap.coop: You show the card around and drop it in the corridor. A cleaner hands it back. "Congratulations, sir." You feel smaller than when you started.

recap.default: {winner} sits too long and the sun moves. HR closes at four. The card is safe, but the paperwork will wait until tomorrow.
recap.coop: You sit too long and the sun moves. HR closes at four. The card is safe, but the paperwork will wait until tomorrow.

tie.recap: You both answer at once. Dr. Sule raises an eyebrow. "Only one of you gets the card."

endings.win: Dr. Sule closes the other file and slides the card across. Report Monday, eight o'clock sharp. {loser} leaves with a handshake. Your sister's ₦50,000 is back in her pocket by Tuesday.
endings.loss: You earn the card, but {winner} was in the room first and Dr. Sule had only one slot. Your sister says there will be other ministries.

success.default: Dr. Sule hires you both. Now you share an office, a desk, and a long silence about who called whom first.
success.solo: Dr. Sule slides the card across. Report Monday, eight o'clock sharp. Your sister screams so loud the whole street hears.

endings.fail: You land the job, barely, after a rough day. Dr. Sule tells you he will be watching, and that your sister's name is the only reason he is not worried.

taxi_park.title: Taxi Park
taxi_park.text: 8am. The taxi drops you at the park behind the ministry. Okada men shout, touts fight over passengers and a woman fries akara beside an open gutter. The white building is right there, but the front queue is already long and nobody knows where the staff gate is. "Oga, where you dey go?" three people ask at once.
taxi_park.stakes: Only one door opens fast. Pick the wrong one and the 2pm slot is gone before you reach the gate.

choices.label: Buy akara and ask the woman which gate the staff use
Push through the touts and join the front queue
Tell an okada man you work in the ministry
Stand aside and watch which door the drivers use

recap.default: {winner} buys akara and the woman points with her spoon. "Back gate. Ask for Baba Nuru."
recap.coop: You buy akara and the woman points with her spoon. "Back gate. Ask for Baba Nuru."

recap.default: {winner} shoulders through the touts and reaches the front queue early. A guard says "Wait there" and does not look up.
recap.coop: You shoulder through the touts and reach the front queue early. A guard says "Wait there" and does not look up.

recap.default: {winner} tells an okada man they work in the ministry. He takes them to the nearest government building, which is the wrong one.
recap.coop: You tell an okada man you work in the ministry. He takes you to the nearest government building, which is the wrong one.

recap.default: {winner} watches a line of drivers walk round the side of the building with flasks. They follow them to a shed with a card game going.
recap.coop: You watch a line of drivers walk round the side of the building with flasks. You follow them to a shed with a card game going.

recap.default: {winner} buys the akara and forgets to ask. The woman squints. "Na only akara you wan buy?" They end up in the front queue by default.
recap.coop: You buy the akara and forget to ask. The woman squints. "Na only akara you wan buy?" You end up in the front queue by default.

recap.default: {winner} pushes through and steps on a man's foot. A fight starts. By the time it ends the queue has doubled and ₦500 has left their pocket for the peace.
recap.coop: You push through and step on a man's foot. A fight starts. By the time it ends the queue has doubled and ₦500 has left your pocket for the peace.

recap.default: {winner} tells an okada man they work in the ministry. "Then why you no get ID?" He drops them at the wrong building anyway.
recap.coop: You tell an okada man you work in the ministry. "Then why you no get ID?" He drops you at the wrong building anyway.

recap.default: {winner} watches for ten minutes and learns that every door looks the same. The front queue has doubled.
recap.coop: You watch for ten minutes and learn that every door looks the same. The front queue has doubled.

tie.recap: Nobody moves. A tout grabs your bag and shouts "Oga, make we go!" You follow the crowd to the gate.

interview_waitlist.title: The Waiting List
interview_waitlist.text: Dr. Sule closes your file but does not drop it in the bin. "We will keep your name. There may be a second round next month." Not a yes, not a no. The corridor feels longer than before. Your phone buzzes. It's your sister: "How did it go?"
interview_waitlist.stakes: Not a yes, not a no. She paid ₦50,000, so tell her what it is, no bigger and no smaller.

choices.label: Tell your sister they kept your name
Tell her you will be back at the ministry on Monday
Tell her you got it, just to hear her scream
Say nothing yet and walk to the bus park to think

recap.default: {winner} tells their sister the truth. She is quiet, then: "They kept your name. That is not nothing. Come home, I made jollof."
recap.coop: You tell your sister the truth. She is quiet, then: "They kept your name. That is not nothing. Come home, I made jollof."

recap.default: {winner} says "I will be back Monday." Sister: "That is why I am not worried."
recap.coop: You say "I will be back Monday." Sister: "That is why I am not worried."

recap.default: {winner} lies. Sister screams so loud the phone crackles and somebody in her shop claps. They will have to make it true by Monday.
recap.coop: You lie. Sister screams so loud the phone crackles and somebody in her shop claps. You will have to make it true by Monday.

recap.default: {winner} walks to the bus park in silence. The city is loud and their steps are louder. The second round will need a better answer than today's.
recap.coop: You walk to the bus park in silence. The city is loud and your steps are louder. The second round will need a better answer than today's.

recap.default: {winner} tries to say it and the words come out wrong. Sister hears everything anyway. "Come home," she says.
recap.coop: You try to say it and the words come out wrong. Sister hears everything anyway. "Come home," she says.

recap.default: {winner} says "Monday" like they are reading it off a card. Sister knows. She always knows.
recap.coop: You say "Monday" like you are reading it off a card. Sister knows. She always knows.

recap.default: {winner} lies and forgets the details. "Which office?" Sister asks. The lie is gone before the bus arrives.
recap.coop: You lie and forget the details. "Which office?" Sister asks. The lie is gone before the bus arrives.

recap.default: {winner} walks too long and misses the last bus. They spend the night on a bench opposite the gate, watching it.
recap.coop: You walk too long and miss the last bus. You spend the night on a bench opposite the gate, watching it.

tie.recap: You both call your sisters at the same time, on opposite sides of the ministry gate. Neither of you tells the whole truth.

endings.win: Dr. Sule keeps both names on the list, but he reads yours twice. A week later the call comes: second round, Monday, eight o'clock. {loser} is still waiting for theirs.
endings.loss: Dr. Sule keeps your name on the list, but {winner}'s file stays on top of the pile. Your sister says come home, she made jollof.

success.default: You both walk out with Dr. Sule's direct line and a second interview next month. Neither of you says who was better.
success.solo: You walk out with Dr. Sule's direct line and a second interview next month. Not a yes, but not a no.

endings.fail: They keep your name, but the list is long and the ministry is slow. Your sister says come home, she made jollof.

endings.win: You are still in the corridor when the ministry closes, but {loser} stumbled harder. Dr. Sule picks the one who stayed in the room. The card is yours.
endings.loss: The ministry closes at 4pm and {winner} walks out with the card. Your sister says there will be other ministries.

success.default: You both get through the ministry with your names clean. Whatever happens Monday, your sister will hear that you stood up straight.
success.solo: You get through the ministry with your name clean. Whatever happens Monday, your sister will hear that you stood up straight.

fail.default: The ministry closes at 4pm and you are still in the corridor. Your sister says come home, she made jollof.
fail.solo: The ministry closes at 4pm and you are still in the corridor. Your sister says come home, she made jollof.

epilogues.text: Your sister tells the whole street about the day her brother stood up and spoke. Nobody asks about the ₦50,000.
Baba Nuru now waves you through the gate before you reach it.
Musa saves your number and tells the shed you are the one from Lagos who listens.
Grace puts your name in her notebook, the one she opens only for people she trusts.
You never trust a driver's directions again, and you never forget Room 205.
You count your pocket on the bus home and decide to carry a second envelope next time.
Security still has your name in the big book. Use the front gate for a while.
Your sister hears about the envelopes before you reach home and does not say a word.
